text.text: What are cookies and why are they helpful?
Web cookies are small files that store data related to our site. You can think of cookies as brief notes with relevant details related to your visits on our website.

By ‘reading’ these notes, we can offer you, every time, relevant information and experiences. More specifically, cookies ease web processes and deliver more relevant experiences by remembering your website preferences and visits.
This helps us display only meaningful, targeted content and spare you from non-targeted, irrelevant messages.
